taste:
Bramley Apple Crumble combines slightly tart, soft baked fruit with a thick, buttery topping that gives each spoonful a contrasting crunch. The apples provide the sharper flavour, so this is a useful choice if you want sweetness balanced by fruit rather than a dessert centred on chocolate. Its golden crumble layer adds texture as well as buttery flavour.

Hot, creamy custard brings the elements together, softening the impression of tartness without removing the apple character. The contrast is the main appeal: crunchy topping, yielding fruit and smooth custard in the same spoonful. It suits someone looking for a traditional, warming pub dessert rather than a chocolate pudding.
